newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bonds hold breath ahead of US CPI.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds hold breath ahead of US CPI.

text.p: *Australian bonds were contained to a narrow trading range with the market finding little to go on ahead of the U.S. CPI later today and, more importantly, the FOMC on March 25.
*Westpac's January leading index due 2.30 p.m. (0330 GMT).

Australian bonds were contained to a narrow trading range with the market finding little to go on ahead of the U.S. CPI later today and, more importantly, the Federal Open Market Committee meeting on March 25.

Yields were factionally lower after the long end bounced off the 8.0 percent barrier again during after hours trading, spiking briefly on a 12.2 percent rise in U.S. housing start, which were seen increase the chances of a Fed tightening.
Westpac's January leading index is due to be released at 2.30 p.m. (0330 GMT), but this is not is expected to have any impact with focus remaining very much on the U.S.
The local market recovered some lost ground against the dollar bloc, particularly against Canada.
Meanwhile, the Industrial Relations Commission said no date had been set for a decision on the trade unions living wages claim. There had been some market talk that it would be today.
